texts.zh: 在[system.GetName]星系进行战斗后，[officer.GetName]出现了独特的基因表达。
texts.en: The engagement in the [system.GetName] system has given rise to unique gene expressions in [officer.GetName].

texts.zh: [officer.GetName]用[system.GetName]星系最近发生的战斗实例的特征向量开发了一组新的战术数据。
texts.en: [officer.GetName] has developed a new tactical data set from the feature vectors of the recent combat instance in the [system.GetName] system.

texts.zh: 最近在[system.GetName]星系落败后，指挥官[officer.GetName]就开始怀疑人生、怀疑自己。很明显他已经失去了指挥大型舰队的能力。
texts.en: After the recent defeat in the [system.GetName] system, Commander [officer.GetName] seems to have become more skittish and self-doubting. It has become clear that the Commander is no longer capable of commanding as large formations as before.

# 指挥官获得特质 / Commander Gains Trait

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/leader_events_1.txt:523-580

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 紧急跃迁时（on_emergency_ftl，00_on_actions.txt:2901-2905）随机事件池：leader.10–14 各10/360；舰队有指挥官（统领），特质数少于3且无冲突特质。
  The emergency-FTL random pool (on_emergency_ftl, 00_on_actions.txt:2901-2905): leader.10-14 at 10/360 each; the fleet has a commander with fewer than 3 traits and no conflicting trait.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 指挥官因紧急跃迁的经历获得特质「紧张」（leader_trait_nervous）。
  The commander gains the trait Nervous (leader_trait_nervous) from the emergency jump.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口，选项只带来效果，无后续事件。
  One window; the options only apply effects, no follow-up events.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 除触发条件所列外无额外文明差异。
  No further empire variants beyond the trigger conditions listed.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
